actor_independent_semantic_identity.holding: The semantic identity contains no exact occupant identity. It hashes only the reusable structural-position proof shape and provenance/authority/distinctness/use-ceiling material. An occupant change belongs to a later fact identity and cannot change this semantic identity unless the semantic definition itself is changed.
checks: EXACT_OBJECTIVE_ACTOR_OR_ENTITY_IDENTITY is absent from admitted constitutive requirements and canonical identity material.
The phrase objective actor/entity structural position names the domain of possible occupancy; it does not bind a concrete occupant.

EXACT_EMPLOYER_OR_COUNTERPART_IDENTITY and EXACT_INSTITUTIONAL_RULE_CONTEXT are requirement kinds only; no concrete employer/counterpart or institutional-rule instance is embedded in the semantic candidate hash.

objective_world_and_no_person_state_leak.holding: All positive constitutive requirements are objective relation/context requirements. Self-report, belief, preference, appraisal, motivation, disposition, biography and other person-state shortcuts remain explicitly nonconstitutive/forbidden.

source_claim_provenance_closure.holding: The candidate preserves the exact M10/Wright source worker tip, source-ledger blob and three documentary loci. The frozen extraction supports productive-asset/property relation, exchange/work strategy, active wage-labour counterpart relation and institutional-rule context while separately distinguishing structural positions from incumbents.
source_claim_provenance_closure.authority_ceiling: The source extraction remains evidence only and does not self-issue project semantic authority or actor-fact truth.

distinctness_from_q73a_prev3pos.holding: The repaired candidate is constituted by productive-asset noncontrol plus an active wage-labour counterpart relation under institutional rules. Q73A's owned semantic axis is fiscal incorporation/obligation. Neither semantic identity entails the other, and the repaired candidate preserves the exact baseline fact/owner/variable identity used for the distinction.

constitutive_closure_no_hidden_inference.holding: Materialization cannot infer the position from an employment code, occupation, industry, sector, job title, income, unemployment, manager label, subjective state, bounded-exit restriction, or exploitation classification. All four objective constitutive predicates must be separately proven at the asserted source/context grain.

negative_ceilings.holding: The repaired candidate remains semantic-only and does not emit an actor-indexed PREV3POS fact, current empirical truth, mechanism/channel rule, topology/source-receiver edge, causal-use permission, exploitation fact, person uptake, V555/M2, V3/person state or OBL063 semantics.

deterministic_replay_and_change_sensitiv.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON of canonical_identity_material with lexicographically sorted object keys, compact separators ',', ':', arrays preserved in declared order, no identity/hash field included.
deterministic_replay_and_change_sensitiv.holding: Independent replay reproduces the S01 hash exactly. Mutating semantic name/definition, any constitutive requirement, source tip/blob/loci, semantic owner authority, commission/HQ authority, baseline distinctness, or use ceiling changes the hash. Varying an external occupant identity without changing semantic material leaves the semantic hash unchanged.

later_actor_fact_materializer_suitabilit.holding: The semantic candidate now supplies a stable candidate identity and exact proof shape while leaving instance truth to a separate actor-fact lane. A later materializer must independently bind exact occupant identity, candidate identity, applicability, permission, valid-time/currentness, provenance/dependency and deterministic fact replay.
later_actor_fact_materializer_suitabilit.nonimplication: T01 does not prove that any real actor/entity occupies the position and does not wake direct fact emission.

canonical_identity_material.definition: An objective actor/entity structural position constituted at the asserted source/context grain by both (a) lack of effective control over productive assets sufficient for independent production and (b) an active wage-labour sale relation to an exact employer/counterpart under exact institutional rules.
